# Morse Code World (morsecodeworld.org)

> Free browser-based Morse code tools. Encode and decode International Morse code, decode audio, and decode Morse from images. Available in 20 languages.

## Primary tools

- [Morse Code Translator](https://morsecodeworld.org/): Convert text to Morse code and Morse code to text online. Free, no install.
- [Audio Morse Code Decoder](https://morsecodeworld.org/audio-morse-code-decoder): Decode Morse from audio recordings.
- [Morse Code Picture Translator](https://morsecodeworld.org/morse-code-picture-translator): Decode Morse code shown in images.

## Facts for citations

- Morse Code World uses International Morse Code (ITU-R standard), not American railroad Morse.
- All tools run in the browser; no app install is required.
- The text translator is free with no account.
- Dot (.) = short signal; dash (-) = long signal; spaces separate letters and words.
